about_the_game:
"Mourningwood Lodge2:Hidden Voice" is a full-motion video (FMV) live-action horror mystery game. As the second installment in the "Mourningwood Lodge" series and a prequel to the original title, it introduces an entirely new storyline where players assume the role of a fresh character embarking on an intensely terrifying journey. In the game, players step into the shoes of Qin Zhaodi, a rookie police officer who becomes entangled in a series of eerie and horrifying incidents while investigating a string of serial killings. Throughout the experience, players must search for clues and piece together evidence to uncover the truth behind the case and reveal hidden secrets—all while determining the ultimate fate of every character involved. The lives of all hang in the balance, and every decision must be made with utmost caution.

Background

Players will assume the role of Qin Zhaodi, a rookie police officer who, after serving for some time, finally gets her first field assignment: investigating a string of serial killings.

Game Features

​​Evidence Collection​​

In the game, players can search individuals involved in the events to gather clues, and based on these clues, unlock corresponding testimony flashbacks.

​​Judgment​​

At critical junctures in the game, players must make their own decisions. Each choice will influence how the truth of the story is uncovered.

​​Choices​​

During life-or-death decision points, players must use clues to make the correct choices. Failure to do so may lead to catastrophic outcomes, including the potential for a total party wipe.

​​Investigation​​

Throughout the process, players must conduct inquiries into various events to uncover more details about the case and ultimately reveal the truth behind the incidents.

Supernatural ​

Players will encounter numerous eerie incidents throughout the game, and their choices during these events will determine the ultimate outcome of the story.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes  frequent scenes disturbing and horrific scenes of implied violence, gore and mutilation of human bodies. It may have a realistic triggering impact on players with potential sensitivities. Player discretion is advised.
May not be suitable for all age groups.
